  - Kept as names: 「着工」「出荷」「関門」「歯止め」「計測器」 (start of building, shipping, gate, safeguards, the evaluator). The reviewer suggested 「開発着手」「リリース」「ゲート」 and similar. These words are plain Japanese and are used consistently across several documents, so changing them in one place would break that.
  - Kept 「差別化の要」 (the core differentiator). It is the name of a required section in the plans, and the pipeline's check (pipelines/flow.mjs) looks for it by that name. Renaming it means changing the code too.
  - Applied the four findings the reviewer was unsure about, using my own reading. For example, 「逆に読む」 (read inversely) became 「代理とみなし、減点する」 (treat retention as a proxy for support work and deduct points). If any of my readings is wrong, I'll change it back.
  - Smoothed a few spots where the replacements made a sentence clumsy. In GUARDRAILS.md, for example, 「広く使われる」 had ended up twice in one sentence.
